abilities.name: Brace Up
abilities.description: Once per round, when you or your partner Digimon takes damage, you may spend 6 Hope to make a Reinforce check against DN 10. If you succeed, reduce that damage by the amount you rolled.

abilities.name: Efficient Resolve
abilities.description: Brace Up's Hope cost decreases from 6 to 2.

abilities.name: Iron Will
abilities.description: Brace Up now reduces damage by double the amount you rolled.

abilities.name: Deep Breath
abilities.description: You may spend 4 Hope to add 1d8 to your next roll.

abilities.name: Unshakeable
abilities.description: Brace Up is no longer limited to once per round. You may use it as often as you like.

abilities.name: I've Got You
abilities.description: When an allied Tamer fails a Sincerity skill check, you may spend 6 Hope to let them pass that check instead.
